title: Brick Kart
description: A Mario Kart-style racer built from LEGO-style bricks: 9 big maps in 3 cups (city, windmill meadows, pirate cove, candy valley, jungle ruins, frosty peaks, toy factory, lava castle and a rainbow road in space), gliders, hazards, 16 racers with 13 per race, 8 power-ups, drifting mini-turbos, and 1-4 player split-screen with controller support.
